° Well I say you're full of shit! / tracking no reply! / taking care! °

We prototype a rock-spiked snowball, first scooped and proposed in 1950 (Δ67y). The snowball is bigger than the rock and goes on the outside. It is hand-scale. The rock is a dependent. Snow seems to come from nowhere. (You can dance as if you're collecting it.) We believe the rock-spiked snowball is a discretionary item and is backwards-compatible with other versions of snow. It fits in & out. You won't realise what has happened to you if you are hit with a rock-spiked snowball, but your development environment will disintegrate; along with your experience, the stairwell of the thrower, the Internet coats, capped tiles, etc, will be set outside, in a springy graph solution—until the ludi of community resolves and your heart is broken.
readme: A report on a prototypical snowball with a rock in it, as if it were a perceptron.
